clue.text: Female in cast carrying one over

indicators.note: the cast-in pairing holds the next piece within it, as a bearer carries a load

parts.note: to cast off skin or feathers is to shed them
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An actress in a cast is lugging someone across the stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' looks like a direction but means ended; 'carrying' wraps the pair round I.
explanation.definitionFit: When a match or event is over it has ended, so the two words are synonyms.

clue.text: View of enlisted men invading country

indicators.note: soldiers invading a country end up inside it, so these letters go within the other piece

parts.note: Panama is a Central American country
OR stands for Other Ranks, soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: A soldier's-eye view of troops marching into a foreign land.
explanation.definitionFit: A wide, sweeping view of a landscape is called by this name, so it is a synonym.

clue.text: Jealous resentment of us shown by Greek primate on board

indicators.note: being on a ship means sitting inside it, so the other pieces go within the ship's letters

parts.note: in the phrase on board, the board is a ship's deck, and SS is the abbreviation for steamship
'our' means belonging to us
an ape is a primate

explanation.surface: Someone grumbles that a Greek monkey on a ship has upstaged them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' is the crossword convention of going inside SS (steamship), which supplies the outer letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom, from Aesop's fox, means disparaging what one cannot have out of envy.

clue.text: I must feed Spanish man first

indicators.note: feeding something puts it inside, so this letter goes within the Spanish word

parts.note: senor is the Spanish word for a man or Mr

explanation.surface: A demand to serve the Spanish gentleman before anyone else.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone senior ranks highest or comes first in order of standing.

clue.text: Threatening, bad guy crossing line

indicators.note: the reordered letters straddle the line, holding it within them
bad signals that the letters of guy are spoiled into a new order

explanation.surface: A menacing villain steps over a line drawn in the sand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' rearranges GUY to UGY, and 'crossing' puts L inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An ugly mood or situation is one that looks menacing or dangerous.

clue.text: With great delight, beat American singing group

parts.note: glee is great joy
to club someone is to beat them

explanation.surface: Someone joyfully thrashes an American choir.
explanation.definitionFit: A school or college choir in the US is commonly called by this name.

clue.text: Just the jacket for a trainspotter?

definitions.text: Just the jacket for a trainspotter?

parts.words: Just the jacket for a trainspotter?
parts.note: the hooded waterproof coat stereotypically worn by trainspotters has also become slang for an obsessive enthusiast

explanation.walkthrough: In Britain the word for the jacket is also slang for a nerdy hobbyist like a trainspotter (someone who logs train numbers).
explanation.definitionFit: A cryptic definition: the coat that gave its name to the stereotypical train enthusiast.

clue.text: A warming drink, for example — good number had before start of game

indicators.note: these pieces come ahead of the final letter in the build
start of means the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A cosy hot drink, say, enjoyed before a game begins.
explanation.definitionFit: This creamy spiced drink of eggs, milk and spirits is a traditional winter warmer.

clue.text: Stream of abuse from traffic island being received

indicators.note: the commerce word takes in the island letter, receiving it inside

parts.note: to traffic is to trade, especially illicitly

explanation.surface: A road-rage rant shouted at a driver stuck on a traffic island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'traffic island' reads as one thing but splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A long angry speech of criticism is a synonym for a stream of abuse.

clue.text: Gigolo, worried about editor, is to stay in hiding

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go about, or around, the editor's abbreviation
worried signals the letters of the gigolo are agitated into a new order

explanation.surface: A ladies' man, anxious about a newspaper editor, decides to keep his head down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'worried' makes LIOGGO, which 'about' wraps round the editor.
explanation.definitionFit: The informal British idiom means to keep still and quiet to avoid being found.

clue.text: Small part of my intro I improvised

indicators.note: improvised signals these letters are made up anew in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A performer admits a little of the opening was made up on the spot.
explanation.definitionFit: A small number or portion of a larger whole is called a minority.

clue.text: Working daily, at first, for legendary boatman

indicators.note: the cleaner word is placed first, ahead of the other piece

parts.note: a daily is a British cleaner who comes in each day, also called a char
a machine that is working is on

explanation.surface: A cleaning lady, at the start of her career, ferries people across a river.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'daily' is a British domestic cleaner, also called a char; 'at first' sets her ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth he ferried the souls of the dead across the river Styx.

clue.text: Histrionic article appearing before a court case involving clubs

parts.note: the is the definite article

indicators.note: the court case wraps around the card suit, involving it inside

parts.note: a trial is a court case
C is the abbreviation for clubs in card games

explanation.surface: A melodramatic piece about a trial concerning golf clubs or nightclubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe exaggerated, stagey behaviour meant for effect.

clue.text: Introduction of conscription, soon to become law

indicators.note: the introduction of a word is its first letter

parts.note: anon is an old word for soon

explanation.surface: A warning that the military draft will shortly be made legally binding.
explanation.definitionFit: A canon is a church law or general rule, a synonym for law.

clue.text: One may be found in the kitchen clearing table

definitions.text: One may be found in the kitchen

parts.note: draining a sink or pan clears it of liquid
a board is a table, as in bed and board

explanation.surface: A cleared-off table might be found in a kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: The ridged surface beside a sink where washed dishes drip is a kitchen fixture.

clue.text: Reportedly understands seedy bar's sharp decline

indicators.note: reportedly means as said in speech, so the word is replaced by one sounding the same

parts.note: to know something is to understand it
a dive is a disreputable bar

explanation.surface: Rumour says someone grasps why a grubby pub's fortunes have collapsed.
explanation.definitionFit: A plummeting fall, as of prices or an aircraft, is a sharp drop.

clue.text: Terribly sad about nation, per what was said before

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go about, or around, the nation word
terribly signals the letters of sad are thrown into disorder

parts.note: a state is a nation

explanation.surface: Someone is very upset about their country, as previously mentioned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Terribly' makes ASD, which 'about' wraps round the nation.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in accordance with what was previously declared or specified.

clue.text: What prolific sketchers do to decide an issue?

definitions.meaning: busy artists produce many sketches, so they make many pictures
choosing by picking straws or tickets settles a question by chance

explanation.surface: Artists who sketch a great deal settle a dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: Settling a matter by random selection, as with straws, is the idiomatic phrase.

clue.text: Correspondence from leader of insurgents within group

indicators.note: within places that letter inside the group word

parts.note: a party is a group of people

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A letter comes from the head of a rebel faction.
explanation.definitionFit: Correspondence in the sense of equality or matching values is a synonym.

clue.text: Dancer's award put in auction

indicators.note: put in places the honour inside the auction word

parts.note: a sale is an auction
OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour

explanation.surface: A performer's medal goes under the hammer.
explanation.walkthrough: OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour awarded by the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible she danced for Herod and asked for John the Baptist's head.

clue.text: Just nips in here to be served, where potential lovers drink?

definitions.text: Just nips in here to be served, where potential lovers drink?

parts.words: Just nips in here to be served, where potential lovers drink?
parts.note: nips are small measures of spirits, and a venue for unattached people looking for partners is wittily read as one serving single measures

explanation.walkthrough: A 'single' is a single measure of spirits, so a place serving only nips could bear the name of a pick-up venue.
explanation.definitionFit: A cryptic definition of a bar frequented by unattached people hoping to meet partners.

clue.text: Hang on, beginning to get aboard vessel

indicators.note: aboard puts that letter inside the ship

parts.note: a liner is a large passenger ship

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone is told to wait as boarding of the ship begins.
explanation.definitionFit: To hang on is to wait or stay around longer, a synonym.

clue.text: Prudence holding a fine decanter

indicators.note: the caution word holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: prudence is care or caution
F is the pencil abbreviation for fine

explanation.surface: A woman called Prudence is clutching a nice wine jug.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prudence' looks like a woman's name but is the common noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A glass vessel for serving wine or water is a kind of decanter.

clue.text: Top tavern in place abroad

indicators.note: in puts the tavern word inside the rearranged letters
abroad means scattered widely, so the letters of place are spread into a new order

parts.note: an inn is a tavern

explanation.surface: A first-rate pub somewhere overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abroad' makes PACLE, and 'in' sets the tavern inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest point or peak of something is its top.

clue.text: Forward in super team

indicators.note: in shows the letters lie within the two words super team

explanation.surface: A striker playing in an excellent side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Forward' suggests a football position, but it means cheeky.
explanation.definitionFit: Forward in the sense of cheeky or bold is a synonym of this word.

clue.text: Cause of addiction revealed by knight I notice shaking

parts.note: N is the chess notation for a knight

indicators.note: shaking signals these letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A knight confesses the shakes of withdrawal from a habit.
explanation.definitionFit: The chemical in tobacco is what makes smokers dependent on it.

clue.text: Contests cases

definitions.meaning: sporting contests or races at a meeting
occurrences, as in in the event or in the case of

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: items on an athletics programme, and things that happen or occur.

clue.text: Comp, sort crossword compiler put together

parts.note: a type is a sort or kind
the setter is the person who compiles a crossword

explanation.surface: A puzzle compiler and a type of person combine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Comp' is short for compositor, a printer who arranges type.
explanation.definitionFit: A compositor is a printing worker who sets type by hand or machine.
